prompt: Show 5 tourist attractions in Bengaluru with ratings, short descriptions and Maps links.
response_text:
# Top Tourist Attractions in Bengaluru

Bengaluru blends historic royal heritage, lush botanical gardens, and modern cultural monuments across its urban landscape. The following five landmarks are among the city's most visited and highly rated destinations.

## Landmark Comparison Table

| Attraction | Category | Rating | Key Highlights |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bangalore Palace** | Heritage & Architecture | 4.2 / 5.0 | Tudor Revival architecture, royal artifacts, manicured grounds |
| **Lalbagh Botanical Garden** | Nature & Horticulture | 4.4 / 5.0 | Historic 1890 Glass House, century-old trees, serene lake |
| **Cubbon Park** | Nature & Recreation | 4.6 / 5.0 | 300 acres of shaded green walking paths, colonial statues, library |
| **ISKCON Temple Bangalore** | Culture & Spirituality | 4.7 / 5.0 | Grand hilltop shrine, ornate gopurams, tranquil prayer halls |
| **Bannerghatta Biological Park** | Wildlife & Conservation | 4.3 / 5.0 | Wildlife safari, butterfly sanctuary, zoological rescue center |

## Top 5 Landmarks to Visit

### Bangalore Palace
Media: Image=https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/Bangalore%20Palace%20-%20Jayamahal.jpg Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Built in 1878 by the Mysore royal family, this palace is renowned for its Tudor Revival architecture, fortified towers, and wood carvings.
- Visitors can explore 35 ornate rooms showcasing vintage photos, hunting trophies, and Victorian-era furnishings.
- **Rating**: 4.2 / 5.0
Action: [Button: Open in Maps] https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Bangalore+Palace

### Lalbagh Botanical Garden
Media: Image=https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/Lalbagh%20botanical%20garden%20,bangalore,India.jpg Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Commissioned in 1760 by Hyder Ali and developed by Tipu Sultan, this 240-acre garden houses over 1,000 rare plant species.
- Its centerpiece is the Victorian Glass House modeled after London's Crystal Palace, which hosts famous bi-annual flower shows.
- **Rating**: 4.4 / 5.0
Action: [Button: Open in Maps] https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Lalbagh+Botanical+Garden

### Cubbon Park
Media: Image=https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/Cubbon%20Park%20W.jpg Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Spanning 300 acres in the heart of Bengaluru's central business district, Cubbon Park serves as the city's green lung.
- Ideal for morning walks and peaceful outings, it houses the State Central Library, bandstands, and statues surrounded by dense greenery.
- **Rating**: 4.6 / 5.0
Action: [Button: Open in Maps] https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Cubbon+Park+Bengaluru

### ISKCON Temple Bangalore
Media: Image=https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/ISKCON%20Temple%20-%20Bangalore%20-%20Karnataka%20-%20DSCN0101.jpg Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/star.svg
- Situated atop Hare Krishna Hill in Rajajinagar, this complex is one of the largest ISKCON centers in the world.
- The temple blends modern glass-and-stone architectural styles with traditional Dravidian stone craftsmanship, drawing thousands of devotees and tourists daily.
- **Rating**: 4.7 / 5.0
Action: [Button: Open in Maps] https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=ISKCON+Temple+Bangalore

### Bannerghatta Biological Park
Media: Image=https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/Bannerghatta%20National%20Park%20(Bannerghatta%20Biological%20Park).jpg Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/compass.svg
- Situated 22 km south of the city center, this ecological park offers close encounters with tigers, lions, and Asian elephants via guided bus safaris.
- The facility includes a dedicated butterfly park conservatory, a zoo, and a wildlife rescue center.
- **Rating**: 4.3 / 5.0
Action: [Button: Open in Maps] https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Bannerghatta+Biological+Park

## Quick Actions
Action: [Button: View Bengaluru Map] https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Bengaluru+Attractions
Action: [Button: Karnataka Tourism] https://www.karnatakatourism.org

## Sources
- Karnataka Tourism Official Portal: https://www.karnatakatourism.org
- Incredible India Destination Guide: https://www.incredibleindia.gov.in
